## Core Services
1. Fully Agentic Application Development: Autonomous multi-agent swarms constructing robust production applications under architectural contracts and self-healing test loops.
2. Spec-Kit AI Systems & Workflows: Transforming enterprise requirements into formal, executable domain specifications before agentic synthesis.
3. Enterprise Software Architecture: High-throughput Java 21 / Spring Boot and PHP 8.3 / Symfony microservices, CQRS, Event-Driven, Azure Cloud (Bicep/ARM).
4. High-Load Data & Spatial Telemetry: Databricks, Azure Data Factory, IoT recursive asset tracking engines, Smallworld & ESRI GIS.

## Agent Governance Layer (Published Proof)
The Zero AI Slop guarantee is enforced by version-controlled constraints that every agent reads before writing code: 11 rules, 10 workflows, 14 role-scoped skills, a 6-stage specification pipeline, and a 7-question self-review answered in writing on every pull request.
- Merge gate ("No test, no merge"): npm run type-check, npm run lint, bin/phpunit, npx playwright test - all must pass before an agent may report a task complete.
- 6-stage pipeline: Specify, Clarify, Plan, Generate tasks, Analyze, Implement.
- Readable excerpt (5 of 35 files, client specifics removed): https://apsw.pl/#governance
